item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance link support for availability groups with multiple databases
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance link now supports extending a SQL Server Always On Availability Group with multiple databases to Azure SQL Managed Instance. You can use this with either an existing availability group or a newly created one.

  • Source: Azure Updates
